item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Congratulations to our Turkey Trot Runners! Due to Thanksgiving Monday, we will have our Gr. 7/8 Cross Country Practice afterschool on Tuesday until 3:30PM. Hope to see you there.

item.title: A Message from: Mme Perron
item.description: There will be a VERY important Europe Team Meeting Tuesday, October 14th at lunch to finalize the Trivia Night on Saturday, October 17th. All travelers must attend. Please bring your lunch!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: The Weight Room is closed today at lunch due to the football game. It will be open next week on Tuesday afterschool - Wednesday- Thursday and Friday at lunch! Drop by to check it out and sign up for your oreintation session if you wish to train here at school. Please chat with Mrs. Longval if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mrs. Curtis:
item.description: All Grade 8 Girls who signed up for the Skilled Trades Lab are asked to see Mrs. Curtis today to pick up their persmission forms.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Today our grade 12 religion classes will help deliver all our food donations to the Good Neighbours Foodbank in Embrun. Those who have submitted the permission form, please come to the atrium at 8:45am this morning to begin loading the food. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Our Costa Rica Service Team is doing Little Caesars pizza kits again! Today, someone will come to your class to deliver Little Caesars pizza kit order forms, and we encourage you to support this great cause!
